description: Total National Produced Energy is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This Dataset represents the total energy produced nationally. It is composed of the following elements: DGM (Market Generation Diagram) referring to the energy production of producers that are on the market - Information provided by REN; PRE (Special Regime Production) referring to the energy production of producers under special regime; Sum of DGM and PRE ... Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consumption and Energy, Renewables. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
